title: Thread boundaries in the data model, and history scoped to a thread
summary: Add a chat_mode flag on WebChatConversation, a web_chat_threads table, and smarter_dev/web/chat/threads.py; floor the worker's _structured_history (and its compaction lookup) to the current thread so a boundary hides earlier messages from the model. Backend only — no conversation is marked quick yet, so existing chats are byte-identical.

title: The Quick chat surface: route, rail entry, and thread dividers
summary: Add GET /chat/quick, which gets-or-creates one perpetual Quick chat per person and pins it above the rail's recency groups, and render thread boundaries as dividers in all three places the stream is built — the Jinja loop, controller._chat_context, and chat.js syncThread. Nothing draws a boundary yet; dividers are tested against directly-inserted thread rows.

title: The agent's start_new_thread tool
summary: Give the root chat agent a start_new_thread(reason) tool plus a QUICK_THREAD_GUIDANCE prompt section, registered only in a Quick chat that has prior exchanges and capped to one call per turn, so a clear topic break draws a boundary in front of the message being answered and every later turn starts on a clean context.

title: The idle evaluator: DeepSeek V4 Flash decides after a long gap
summary: Add admin-only thread evaluator settings (model defaulting to the catalog's deepseek-v4, a fallback, and an idle threshold defaulting to 15 minutes) and a fail-open classifier that runs before _structured_history when a Quick chat has been idle past the threshold, drawing a boundary so the chat model never loads the previous subject. Completes the feature.
